pregnancy.label: Clinical pregnancy education
pregnancy.reference: Reviewed by the Rea editorial team

pregnancy_01_04.title: Weeks 1–4
pregnancy_01_04.body: Early dates can feel uncertain. Rea shows the week from the date you declared and keeps its basis visible.

pregnancy_05_08.title: Weeks 5–8
pregnancy_05_08.body: Early development changes quickly. Record how you feel without turning one signal into a conclusion.

pregnancy_09_12.title: Weeks 9–12
pregnancy_09_12.body: The first trimester is nearing its close. A conversation with your professional can help answer questions about care.

pregnancy_13_16.title: Weeks 13–16
pregnancy_13_16.body: For many people the second trimester brings changes in energy, appetite and sleep that can vary widely.

pregnancy_17_20.title: Weeks 17–20
pregnancy_17_20.body: Appointments and ultrasound can feel different for everyone. Your entries support a conversation, not a diagnosis.

pregnancy_21_24.title: Weeks 21–24
pregnancy_21_24.body: Keep noting symptoms and wellbeing without chasing a perfect curve. Individual variation is expected.

pregnancy_25_28.title: Weeks 25–28
pregnancy_25_28.body: Some sensations may become more noticeable. If something worries you, ask your professional even without an app alert.

pregnancy_29_32.title: Weeks 29–32
pregnancy_29_32.body: Rest and movement can change. Rea helps you remember what happened and does not replace care.

pregnancy_33_36.title: Weeks 33–36
pregnancy_33_36.body: Preparing for birth can bring practical and emotional questions. Choose what you want to record.

pregnancy_37_40.title: Weeks 37–40
pregnancy_37_40.body: The estimated due date is a reference, not a promise. Every pregnancy has its own rhythm.

pregnancy_41_42.title: Weeks 41–42
pregnancy_41_42.body: If the estimated date has passed, talk with your professional about appropriate follow-up; Rea will not rush you.
